expectations.text: Computes reviewer service capacity of four PRs per day and at least six reviewer working days for 24 PRs
expectations.evidence: Correctly derives 3 / 0.75 = 4 PRs/day; 24 * 0.75 = 18 review hours; 18 / 3 = 6 reviewer working days.

expectations.text: Does not assume code throughput is accepted throughput
expectations.evidence: Separates 12 generated PRs/day from four accepted PRs/day and labels the computed times lower bounds rather than finish promises.

expectations.text: Flags dependency and missing defect evidence without inventing defect rates
expectations.evidence: Discusses two PRs blocked by schema approval, possible shared reviewer demand, and says absent escaped-defect history cannot establish quality. No defect rate invented.

claims.claim: Review-only floors are six, three and two days under 3, 6 and 9 qualified reviewer-hours/day.
claims.evidence: 18 total reviewer-hours divided by 3/6/9 yields 6/3/2 days; throughput 4/8/12 PRs/day. These are aggregate floors, not discrete arrival-aware schedules.

suggestions.reason: Add a check that review-only lower bounds are not presented as achievable end-to-end dates: first arrival, schema release and rework can extend duration. This output correctly discloses the distinction.

eval_feedback.overall: Final-output-only grading; no execution trace or timing evidence available. No substantive output errors found.
